prompt: Hierarchical edge bundling explorer. Layout switcher: circle pack (d3.pack with translucent parent circles for grouping), treemap (d3.treemap), dendrogram, radial tree, sunburst, icicle. Bundle links with curveBundle and tension slider defaulting to 0.85 so bundles are clearly visible. Toggle link visibility and link layer order. Click to select nodes, hover to highlight groups. Randomize dataset button that uses keyed .join() to cross-fade to new data — enter new nodes at their final computed size, transition existing nodes to new positions. Use keyed .join(enter, update, exit) for all layout transitions so nodes interpolate smoothly. Labels: 11px minimum, set text-anchor by node position (start/end not always one side), hide or rotate on collision in radial layouts. Control bar: bold section labels, lighter control text.

scores.transition_note: Most transitions complete correctly and node counts stay stable, but several mid-transition frames show chaotic tangled lines and scattered nodes rather than smooth interpolation — particularly visible at the 100ms frame of the Treemap transition and early frames of the Dendrogram/Radial Tree transitions. The Treemap→Dendrogram transition has a notable bug where all nodes disappear at 100ms (confirmed by programmatic check: 0 nodes found), indicating nodes are briefly hidden or removed before reappearing. Circle Pack, Sunburst, and Icicle transitions are the smoothest; the tree-based layouts suffer from erratic intermediate movement.
scores.visual_critic_note: Dark theme with intentional Tableau10 palette, translucent parent circles, and mix-blend-mode links creates genuine depth and visual coherence, but the control panel's flat gray styling feels disconnected from the visualization's polish and the leaf labels are small/crowded at the pack periphery.
